chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Yaḥyā ibn ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever has intercourse with a menstruating woman, then half a dīnār is upon him, which he gives in charity.

key_terms.دِينَارٍ: a dīnār; the monetary amount of the expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffārah for having intercourse with a menstruating woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who has intercourse with a menstruating woman. It states that he must give half a dīnār in charity as expiation, indicating a financial kaffārah for this prohibited act.
